comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs snap together two links of a five-bar robot leg.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated latch release and withdrawal vs bimanual alignment of free-hanging chains and equal-and-opposite snap-fit pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without bypass or damage vs stud is captured by the jaw and tongue, then remains snapped after release.
comparison.reason: Latch disengagement and extraction are different from compliant snap-fit assembly.
